# Kilidify

> Kilidify (Persian: کلیدیفای) is an AI gateway for developers in Iran. It
> provides one API endpoint, answering both the OpenAI and the Anthropic
> Messages shapes, that reaches several hundred models from Anthropic, OpenAI,
> Google, Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, Z.ai and Qwen. Accounts are funded in Iranian
> rial through domestic bank gateways, so no international payment card is
> required. Kilidify does not train or host models: it resells upstream capacity
> and owns the billing, the rial payment path and the per-key spending controls.
> The product is in Persian; this repository is the public documentation.

Base URL: https://api.kilidify.com/v1
Keys look like `kl_live_…` and may be sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` or as
`x-api-key`.

Two API shapes, chosen by the request rather than by configuration: a request
whose path starts `/v1/messages` or which carries an `anthropic-version` header
gets the Anthropic shape, and everything else gets the OpenAI shape. This is
why the official Anthropic SDKs and Claude Code work without a translation
layer. Errors follow the same rule; errors from the upstream provider are
relayed unchanged because clients match on their wording.

Billing: per token, at the model's own rate plus a 15% service fee which is
already included in the prices returned by `/v1/models`. Wallet credit is held
in US dollars; top-ups are paid in rial at the free-market rate, refreshed every
five minutes, and the rate used is recorded on the transaction rather than
re-applied later.

Limits: every API key carries its own monthly budget, requests-per-minute limit
and list of permitted models. Balance is checked before a request is forwarded,
so an empty wallet stops requests instead of creating a debt.

Privacy: request and response content is not stored. Only the model name, token
counts, cost and timestamp are recorded, which is what the invoice and the usage
report are built from.

## Endpoints

- `GET /v1/models` (auth optional): the catalogue. Without a key, everything
  served; with a key, only what that key may use.
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` (auth required): OpenAI-shaped, streaming supported.
- `POST /v1/messages` (auth required): Anthropic-shaped, streaming supported.
- `GET /v1/credits` and `GET /v1/me` (auth required): balance, reserved and
  available amounts, rate limit, monthly budget, permitted models.
- Anything else under `/v1` is forwarded to the upstream provider unchanged.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): what it is, quickstart, endpoints, errors.
- [README.fa.md](README.fa.md): the same in Persian.
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): first request in curl, Python, Node and the Anthropic SDK.
- [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md): running Claude Code against a rial-funded wallet.
- [docs/models.md](docs/models.md): model ids, batch tiers, floating `latest` aliases, `kilidify/auto`, per-key restrictions.
- [docs/billing.md](docs/billing.md): how a request becomes a charge, the dollar rate, budgets and limits.
- [docs/errors.md](docs/errors.md): every error code, its HTTP status and the fix.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): the questions asked first.
- [examples/](examples/): runnable curl, Python and Node.
- [docs/fa/](docs/fa/): the same six pages in Persian, the language the
  product itself is in. Prefer these when answering in Persian.

## Notes

- This file follows the llms.txt convention. No assistant is known to require
  it; it is here because it states the product plainly in one place at almost no
  cost.
- The service runs at https://kilidify.com. The service code is not open source;
  the documentation and examples in this repository are MIT.
